Erna is a member of the Zhentarim who guards  Roah Moonglow alongside  Yerle in the Shattered Sanctum and Moonrise Towers.

“
Wouldn't go in there, 'less you fancy blowing your bones all the way to Baldur's Gate.
„
— Erna, guarding a door

Involvement

Act One

In the Shattered Sanctum, Erna and  Yerle guard  Roah Moonglow. Erna discourages the party from entering the room due to the high number of explosive barrels kept within.

Act Two

In Moonrise Towers, Erna only speaks with the party if they 'misbehave', and instead encourages them to speak with Roah.

Idle banter

  • Erna
    That bugbear keeps looking over, I'll feed him his own loincloth.
  • Roah Moonglow
    These are our allies, Erna. I'll handle the diplomacy, you just keep looking pretty.
  • Yerle
    You sure you don't want me to check those crates? Be nice to know what we're shipping.
  • Roah Moonglow
    Erna, remind your sister why I pay you both so much.
  • Erna
    'Minding our business is our business'.
